title: CheckoutRejected
description: Reply (ADR 0007). Published by order-service through its outbox (key = cartId): nothing was placed and every reservation of the checkout is released (BR-ORD-14). Consumed by cart-service, which returns the cart to ACTIVE with a new version and shows the reasons per store or line, only when id, version and status CHECKING_OUT match. No personal data.

causationId.description: eventId of the PlaceCheckout it answers.

checkoutId.description: Present when a checkout row was stored (STALE, EXPIRED or a rejected placement).

code.description: Line codes INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, NOT_ORDERABLE and UNKNOWN_SKU pass inventory's StockReservationRejected reasons through unchanged; RESERVE_TIMEOUT = no reserve reply in time, or inventory answered STALE_COMMAND; RESERVE_FAILED = inventory answered ORDER_CLOSED. CONTENT_MISMATCH is not an outcome for the cart (the first checkout of the key stands). STALE and EXPIRED are stored under the key, so a later copy of the command re-publishes them (ADR 0007).

deliveryFee.description: Only for DELIVERY_FEE_CHANGED: the new fee, shown to the customer before they confirm again (BR-PRC-03).
